--- create_model_struct_array_sized.sql
CREATE MODEL m
INPUT (x STRUCT<a ARRAY<STRING(MAX)>>)
OUTPUT (y STRUCT<b ARRAY<BYTES(MAX)>>)
REMOTE

--- AST
&ast.CreateModel{
  Remote: 93,
  Name:   &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 13,
    NameEnd: 14,
    Name:    "m",
  },
  InputOutput: &ast.CreateModelInputOutput{
    Input:        15,
    Rparen:       91,
    InputColumns: []*ast.CreateModelColumn{
      &ast.CreateModelColumn{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 22,
          NameEnd: 23,
          Name:    "x",
        },
        DataType: &ast.StructType{
          Struct: 24,
          Gt:     51,
          Fields: []*ast.StructField{
            &ast.StructField{
              Ident: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 31,
                NameEnd: 32,
                Name:    "a",
              },
              Type: &ast.ArrayType{
                Array: 33,
                Gt:    50,
                Item:  &ast.SizedSchemaType{
                  NamePos: 39,
                  Rparen:  49,
                  Name:    "STRING",
                  Max:     true,
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
    OutputColumns: []*ast.CreateModelColumn{
      &ast.CreateModelColumn{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 62,
          NameEnd: 63,
          Name:    "y",
        },
        DataType: &ast.StructType{
          Struct: 64,
          Gt:     90,
          Fields: []*ast.StructField{
            &ast.StructField{
              Ident: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 71,
                NameEnd: 72,
                Name:    "b",
              },
              Type: &ast.ArrayType{
                Array: 73,
                Gt:    89,
                Item:  &ast.SizedSchemaType{
                  NamePos: 79,
                  Rparen:  88,
                  Name:    "BYTES",
                  Max:     true,
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE MODEL m INPUT (x STRUCT<a ARRAY<STRING(MAX)>>) OUTPUT (y STRUCT<b ARRAY<BYTES(MAX)>>) REMOTE
